A <br> just after <a> is kept as a hard line break in the label

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "beta<a href=\"https://example.com\"><br>_alpha</a>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
